description_en: Starts a data migration task of Data Transmission Service (DTS)
kebab_example: aliyun dts start-migration-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --migration-job-id dtss0611o8vv900000 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-aekz4us4iruleja --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartMigrationJob

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the data migration instance. You can call the **DescribeMigrationJobs** operation to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移实例ID，可以通过调用**DescribeMigrationJobs**接口查询
parameters.name: migration_job_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
